name: tpl-existence-2-goal
task: Open the door and pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task commands two events — opening the door and picking up the target box — with no stated order between them. The hard Existence(door_open) and hard Existence(target_picked_up) each make one of them happen, and the machine's final state u3 is reached only when both have occurred. The environment's constraint that the box cannot be picked up before the door is open means the effective order holds regardless; the clauses express exactly what the task states.

texts: Open the door at least once.
Pick up the target box at least once.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u3
(u1, door_open) -> u3
(u2, target_picked_up) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up, u1) -> 1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up, u2) -> 1
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up, u3) -> 12
